subtitle: 초기화 안 한 딜 미터기로 훈수 둔 흑마의 최후

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
야 냥꾼 니 딜 왜 바닥이냐?
인던에서 버스 타냐?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle boastful dungeon shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text, numbers, or speech bubbles. On the left, cocky Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) shoves a glowing fantasy crystal damage-meter tablet forward displaying simple colored horizontal gauge bars only (a long purple bar on top and a tiny short green bar at bottom) with a smug sneer while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) puffs its chest smugly beside her. On the right, chill Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) leans in squinting calmly at the bars while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf tilts his head curiously beside her.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
님 그거 이전 던전 기록
초기화 안 하고 누적된 건데요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Human Warlock (dark-purple hood and cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with starry belly and gold bracers in lower-left foreground) looking at Dwarf Hunter on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background (zero text, numbers, or speech bubbles). On the right, unbothered Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) taps a pointing finger calmly toward the unreset crystal meter tablet with a relaxed knowing half-smile while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf nods matter-of-factly beside her.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue:
흥 초기화해도 내가 1등이지!
자 지금 눌렀다… 어?
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle comedic reveal shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text, numbers, or speech bubbles. On the left, cocky Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) pokes a glowing cyan reset crystal on the floating damage-meter tablet, freezing mid-smirk as the simple colored horizontal gauge bars instantly reshuffle so a long green bar surges to the top and a tiny stubby purple bar drops to dead last, while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) widens its eyes in alarm. On the right, Troll Shaman (single wooden totem staff stowed on back) leans in peering closely at the flipped colored bars with amazed widening eyes.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 82 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with pale vertical shock gloom lines and zero text or speech bubbles. Human Warlock (dark-purple hooded robe, black twin pigtails with purple tips, empty trembling hands) turns ghost-pale in sheer busted horror with tiny blank pinpoint eyes and pouring cold sweat while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) shrinks back sweating nervously beside her cheek.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
어, 리셋하니까 님이 꼴찌네요?
버스 잘 타고 계셨네
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic roast shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, chill Dwarf Hunter (single blunderbuss rifle stowed on back) gives an innocent deadpan grin gesturing gently with empty hands while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round chubby brown baby bear wearing a green scarf smugly crosses his stubby arms beside her. On the right, bright-red mortified Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) yanks her dark-purple hood down over her eyes trembling in shame as her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) covers its eyes with its tiny gold-bracered hands.

cuts.speaker: 트롤 주술사
cuts.dialogue:
푸하하! 말도 없이 파티 탈퇴!
자기 발등 찍고 도망갔네!
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view wide slapstick comic finale in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal dungeon stone floor touch and zero text or speech bubbles. On the left, Troll Shaman (single wooden totem staff stowed on back) doubles over clutching her stomach laughing uproariously with joyful tears pointing toward the exit. On the right, mortified Human Warlock (spellbook stowed) sprints silently away at full speed in a frantic comic dust cloud leaving the dungeon while her cute 2.5-head chibi SD round squishy floating purple Voidwalker (starry belly, gold bracers) scrambles desperately behind her.
